snippet.title: Camping Resort Simulator | Early Access Trailer – November 4 on Steam
snippet.description:
Turn an empty stretch of coast into the campsite everyone wants to come back to. 🏕️

Camping Resort Simulator opens in Early Access on Steam on November 4, 2026.
Lay out pitches, glamping tents, bungalows and villas, open a lagoon pool with water slides, a beach bar and an open-air cinema, and watch every guest live their own holiday.

🌴 Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952320/Camping_Resort_Simulator/
🌐 Website: https://campingresortsimulator.com
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/hqvbcvvrhC
📰 Press kit and contact: press@campingresortsimulator.com

Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese.

#CampingResortSimulator #EarlyAccess #CozyGames #ManagementGame #Tycoon #Simulation #IndieGame #Steam
